title: John Chapter 6 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on John chapter 6 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: John Chapter 6 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of John Chapter 6.

questions.question: What sea did Jesus go over in John 6?
questions.explanation: Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is also called the sea of Tiberias, as stated in John 6:1.

questions.question: Why did a great multitude follow Jesus?
questions.explanation: The multitude followed Jesus because they saw the miracles which he did on those that were diseased, as mentioned in John 6:2.

questions.question: Who did Jesus ask about buying bread for the multitude?
questions.explanation: Jesus specifically asked Philip, 'Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?' as stated in John 6:5.

questions.question: How many barley loaves did the lad have?
questions.explanation: The lad had five barley loaves and two small fishes, as noted in John 6:9.

questions.question: How many baskets were filled with fragments after the feeding of the five thousand?
questions.explanation: After gathering the fragments, they filled twelve baskets with the leftovers from the five barley loaves, according to John 6:13.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus distributed the loaves after giving thanks.
questions.explanation: Jesus took the loaves and, after giving thanks, distributed them to the disciples, as stated in John 6:11.

questions.question: True or False: The people wanted to make Jesus a king after the miracle.
questions.explanation: The men wanted to take Jesus by force to make him a king after seeing the miracle, which is mentioned in John 6:15.

questions.question: What did Jesus say to his disciples when they were afraid on the sea?
options: It is I; be not afraid
questions.correctAnswer: It is I; be not afraid
questions.explanation: Jesus reassured his disciples by saying, 'It is I; be not afraid,' as recorded in John 6:20.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about laboring for food?
options: Labor not for meat which perisheth
questions.correctAnswer: Labor not for meat which perisheth
questions.explanation: Jesus instructed them not to labor for the perishable food but for the food that endures to everlasting life, as stated in John 6:27.

questions.question: True or False: The Jews murmured because Jesus claimed to be the bread from heaven.
questions.explanation: The Jews murmured at Jesus because he said he was the bread which came down from heaven, as stated in John 6:41.

questions.question: In what order did Jesus feed the multitude and then walk on water?
options: He did both at the same time
questions.explanation: Jesus first fed the multitude before walking on the sea, as the feeding of the five thousand occurs before the account of him walking on water.

questions.question: What did the people do when they realized Jesus was not with his disciples?
questions.explanation: The people took shipping and came to Capernaum seeking for Jesus when they realized he was not there, as stated in John 6:24.

medium.title: John Chapter 6 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from John Chapter 6 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What did Jesus say when the multitude sought him after they had eaten the loaves and were filled?
options: Ye seek me because of the miracles
Ye seek me because ye did eat of the loaves
questions.correctAnswer: Ye seek me because ye did eat of the loaves
questions.explanation: Jesus pointed out their motivation for seeking him— they were more interested in the physical satisfaction than the spiritual truths he represented. This is found in John 6:26, where He states, 'Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.'

questions.question: According to John 6:27, what should we labor for?
options: Meat which endureth unto everlasting life
questions.correctAnswer: Meat which endureth unto everlasting life
questions.explanation: In John 6:27, Jesus instructs not to labor for temporary sustenance but for eternal spiritual nourishment, which He, as the Son of Man, will provide. This highlights the importance of prioritizing spiritual over physical needs.

questions.question: What is described as the work of God in John 6:29?
options: To believe on him whom he hath sent
questions.correctAnswer: To believe on him whom he hath sent
questions.explanation: Jesus emphasizes that the primary work God requires is faith in Him—believing in the one God has sent, which is affirmed in John 6:29: 'This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.'

questions.question: What bread did Jesus say He was in John 6:35?
questions.explanation: Jesus reveals His identity as the 'bread of life' in John 6:35, indicating that those who come to Him will never hunger, emphasizing the spiritual sustenance He provides.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus stated that all whom the Father gives Him will be cast out.
questions.explanation: In John 6:37, Jesus assures that He would not cast out anyone that comes to Him, indicating His acceptance and promise of eternal security for believers.

questions.question: What did Jesus claim about the bread of God in John 6:33?
options: It is he which cometh down from heaven
It is for the Jews only
questions.correctAnswer: It is he which cometh down from heaven
questions.explanation: In John 6:33, Jesus identifies the bread of God as Himself, emphasizing His divine origin and role in providing eternal life to the world.

questions.question: What assurance does Jesus give in John 6:40 regarding those who see Him and believe?
questions.explanation: Jesus promises in John 6:40 that all who see the Son and believe in Him will have everlasting life, highlighting the eternal security of faith in Christ.

questions.question: True or False: The Jews murmured at Jesus because He claimed to be the bread which came down from heaven.
questions.explanation: In John 6:41, the Jews indeed murmured at Jesus for stating that He was the bread from heaven, reflecting their doubt and disbelief in His divine nature.

questions.question: According to John 6:44, who can come to Jesus?
questions.explanation: Jesus states in John 6:44 that no one can come to Him unless the Father draws them, emphasizing the divine initiative in salvation.

questions.question: What do the disciples express in response to Jesus' hard teaching in John 6:60?
options: They find it hard to understand
questions.correctAnswer: They find it hard to understand
questions.explanation: In John 6:60, many of His disciples remarked that His teachings were hard, indicating their struggle to comprehend the spiritual truths He was conveying.

questions.question: What did Peter declare in John 6:68 about Jesus?
options: He has the words of eternal life
questions.correctAnswer: He has the words of eternal life
questions.explanation: Peter acknowledged Jesus' unique authority and His message of eternal life in John 6:68, which reveals a deep understanding of Jesus' significance.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus chose twelve disciples, including one who would betray Him.
questions.explanation: In John 6:70, Jesus mentions that He chose twelve disciples and identifies one as a devil, referring to Judas Iscariot, who would betray Him.

hard.title: John Chapter 6 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from John Chapter 6.

questions.question: What did Jesus feed to the multitude in John Chapter 6?
questions.explanation: Jesus fed the multitude with five barley loaves and two small fishes, as mentioned in John 6:9.

questions.question: How many baskets were filled with leftover fragments after the feeding of the 5,000?
questions.explanation: The disciples gathered twelve baskets of fragments that remained after everyone had eaten, as stated in John 6:13.

questions.question: What was the reaction of the people after witnessing Jesus' miracle of feeding the 5,000?
options: They wanted to make Him king
questions.correctAnswer: They wanted to make Him king
questions.explanation: The people wanted to make Jesus a king after seeing the miracle, as noted in John 6:15.

questions.question: In John 6:27, what type of meat does Jesus encourage the people to labor for?
questions.explanation: Jesus tells them not to labor for the meat which perisheth, but for that which endures unto everlasting life, as mentioned in John 6:27.

questions.question: What did Jesus imply about the bread He offers in John 6:51?
questions.explanation: Jesus refers to Himself as the living bread that came down from heaven in John 6:51, indicating the eternal sustenance He provides.

questions.question: Which Old Testament event do the Jews reference to challenge Jesus' claim about bread?
questions.explanation: The Jews refer to the manna that their fathers ate in the desert to challenge Jesus' claim about heavenly bread, as seen in John 6:31.

questions.question: In John 6:63, what does Jesus say about the spirit and the flesh?
options: The flesh is the source of life
questions.explanation: Jesus states that it is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing, emphasizing the importance of spiritual life, as mentioned in John 6:63.

questions.question: What is the significance of the phrase 'I am the bread of life' in John 6:35?
options: It identifies Jesus as a teacher
It signifies Jesus as a miracle worker
It indicates Jesus as essential for spiritual sustenance
It refers to Jesus as a prophet
questions.correctAnswer: It indicates Jesus as essential for spiritual sustenance
questions.explanation: When Jesus declares 'I am the bread of life', He signifies that He is essential for spiritual sustenance and eternal life, as stated in John 6:35.

questions.question: According to John 6:66, what was the response of many disciples after Jesus' hard saying?
options: They went back and walked no more with Him
questions.correctAnswer: They went back and walked no more with Him
questions.explanation: Many of Jesus' disciples turned away and no longer followed Him after hearing His hard teachings, as noted in John 6:66.

questions.question: What does Simon Peter declare about Jesus in John 6:69?
options: He is the Son of God
questions.correctAnswer: He is the Son of God
questions.explanation: Simon Peter declares that they believe Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God, as stated in John 6:69.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus says that He came down from heaven to do His own will.
questions.explanation: Jesus states that He came down from heaven not to do His own will, but the will of Him that sent Him, as indicated in John 6:38.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus claims that only those who eat His flesh and drink His blood will have eternal life.
questions.explanation: Jesus explicitly states that except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink His blood, ye have no life in you, affirming the necessity of this for eternal life in John 6:53.

questions.question: Which literary device is exemplified by the phrase 'I am the bread of life'?
questions.explanation: The phrase 'I am the bread of life' is a metaphor that illustrates Jesus as essential for spiritual nourishment, as found in John 6:35.

questions.question: The concept of bread as life is echoed in which Old Testament book?
questions.explanation: The reference to manna in the wilderness connects to the theme of bread as life, found in Exodus 16:15, which parallels the teaching in John 6 about Jesus as the bread from heaven.

questions.question: In John 6:44, who draws men to Jesus?
questions.explanation: Jesus states that no man can come to Him unless the Father draws him, emphasizing the divine role in salvation, as indicated in John 6:44.

theological.title: John Chapter 6 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from John Chapter 6 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What miracle did Jesus perform to feed the multitude?
options: He multiplied five barley loaves and two fishes
He raised Lazarus from the dead
questions.correctAnswer: He multiplied five barley loaves and two fishes
questions.explanation: Jesus took five barley loaves and two small fishes and multiplied them to feed about five thousand men, as stated in John 6:9-11.

questions.question: What did Jesus tell the disciples to do with the fragments after feeding the multitude?
options: Gather them up that nothing be lost
questions.correctAnswer: Gather them up that nothing be lost
questions.explanation: Jesus instructed his disciples to gather the fragments so that nothing would be lost, which is highlighted in John 6:12.

questions.question: Why did Jesus say to Philip, 'Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?'
options: To find a place to eat
questions.explanation: Jesus asked Philip this question to prove him, knowing what he would do, as stated in John 6:6.

questions.question: What did the people say after witnessing the miracle of feeding the five thousand?
options: This is the prophet that should come into the world
We should follow him to the ends of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: This is the prophet that should come into the world
questions.explanation: The people recognized Jesus as the prophet after seeing the miracle he performed, according to John 6:14.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is demonstrated by Jesus walking on the sea?
questions.explanation: Jesus walking on water illustrates his omnipotence, as he demonstrates authority over natural laws, as described in John 6:19.

questions.question: What is the significance of Jesus declaring, 'I am the bread of life'?
options: He offers eternal sustenance and life
He refers to the manna from heaven
questions.correctAnswer: He offers eternal sustenance and life
questions.explanation: By claiming to be the bread of life, Jesus emphasizes that he provides spiritual nourishment that leads to eternal life, as stated in John 6:35.

questions.question: What did Jesus mean when he said, 'Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you'?
options: He was speaking of spiritual communion with him
He meant to frighten his followers
He was teaching about physical sustenance
questions.correctAnswer: He was speaking of spiritual communion with him
questions.explanation: Jesus was teaching the necessity of believing in him and participating in the new covenant, which is symbolized by eating his flesh and drinking his blood, as explained in John 6:53.

questions.question: How does John 6:27 reflect on the nature of eternal life?
options: It is achieved through good works
It is given by the Son of man
It is only for the Jewish people
questions.correctAnswer: It is given by the Son of man
questions.explanation: Jesus emphasizes that eternal life is a gift from him, the Son of man, and not based on earthly sustenance, as stated in John 6:27.

questions.question: What do verses 28-29 reveal about the work of God?
options: To believe in the one He sent
questions.correctAnswer: To believe in the one He sent
questions.explanation: Jesus states that the work of God is to believe in him whom he has sent, as presented in John 6:29.

questions.question: What did Jesus mean when he indicated that he came down from heaven?
options: He is divine and sent by the Father
He had a vision from God
questions.correctAnswer: He is divine and sent by the Father
questions.explanation: Jesus emphasizes his divine origin and mission sent from the Father, indicating his identity as the Son of God, as recorded in John 6:38.

questions.question: What does John 6:66 signify about the reaction of some disciples to Jesus' teachings?
options: They walked no more with him
questions.correctAnswer: They walked no more with him
questions.explanation: This verse indicates that many disciples turned away from Jesus due to the difficulty of his teachings, specifically concerning his identity and mission as the bread of life, as stated in John 6:66.

questions.question: How does John 6:68 reflect the belief of the twelve apostles?
options: They were uncertain about Jesus' identity
They recognized him as the Christ
They wanted to leave as well
questions.correctAnswer: They recognized him as the Christ
questions.explanation: Simon Peter's declaration shows a deep faith in Jesus as the Christ, emphasizing their belief in his unique role in salvation, as stated in John 6:69.

questions.question: What does the mention of Judas Iscariot in John 6:70 indicate about Jesus' knowledge?
options: He was unaware of Judas' betrayal
He knew who would betray him
questions.correctAnswer: He knew who would betray him
questions.explanation: This verse reveals Jesus' foreknowledge of Judas' betrayal, underlining his divine insight into human hearts, as expressed in John 6:70.

questions.question: What does Jesus' teaching about the true bread from heaven in John 6:32 imply?
options: Physical bread is essential for life
The true sustenance comes from God through Christ
Bread should be our only focus
questions.correctAnswer: The true sustenance comes from God through Christ
questions.explanation: Jesus clarifies that the true bread from heaven is not what Moses provided, but rather himself, who gives life to the world, as noted in John 6:32.

questions.question: How does the concept of believing in Jesus relate to eternal life according to John 6:47?
questions.explanation: Jesus states that believing in him is essential for possessing eternal life, emphasizing the importance of faith in his identity and mission, as articulated in John 6:47.
